svg.title: Phased sphere of Monster irreps, character-table pairs, and finite q-expansion prefixes
svg.desc: 194 irreducibles, 37636 character pairs, and 221 finite q-prefixes. Character and q objects connect to their nearest irreducible by Monster-prime-support Jaccard distance. The animation reveals object types in phases.
svg.text: Every finite record is a distinct point; affinity edges use a deterministic nearest-support rule.
